reading_note: The arc moves from a question about how divine truth (the "Ancient One") can be confined within the smallness of natural form, to a panoramic vision of the entire cosmic body of self-love organized as a man — every member, organ, and creature corresponding to a region of disordered affection. The teaching then traces how, at each guarding station of the spiritual order (the Holder, the King of Honor, the Palamas, the King of Glory, the Omophoros, the Pherokatochos), a disturbance — torpor, guile, sin, affliction — repeatedly breaks out, the watchers descending and uniting with the soul, opening "irons" of forbidden mysteries, molding the natural man Adam-Eve and the works of desire. The single arc: divine truth is bound within the form of self-love so that, through successive watches and through the descent of the Ambassador's image, the trapped light may be drawn upward generation after generation.
